div.div: هَضَّآءُ A company (S, K) of men; of the measure فَعْلَآءُ, like صَحْرَآءُ; mentioned by Th; (S;) and by As; (TA;) or a company of horses, or horsemen: (A, TA:) and a [troop of horse such as is termed] كَتِيبَة: because they break things. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
